paragraphs.text: A minimal DeepSeek Harness community plugin that registers a callable hello tool
A minimal DeepSeek Harness community plugin. It registers a single model-callable tool, `hello`, tha
t greets a caller by name. It is the smallest complete example of a `dsh-plugin` bundle and a good s
tarting point for a first contribution.
When the plugin loads, it registers the `hello` tool on `ctx.tools`:
The `greeting` prefix is configurable and defaults to `Hello`.
`dsh plugin` forwards to pnpm inside the profile directory, so any pnpm install form works:
The first run initializes the profile with `@deepseek-ai/dsh-base`, links this package, and appends
it to the profile's `dsh.profile.bundles` because `package.json` declares `dsh.bundle`. A git instal
l fetches sources, so pnpm runs the `prepare` script to build `lib/` from `src/`. pnpm 10+ refuses t
hat script until it is allowlisted; `dsh` prints the exact `allowBuilds` entry to copy into the prof
ile's `pnpm-workspace.yaml`. Verify the composed layer, then boot:
Ask the model: `Use the hello tool to greet Ada.` It calls `hello` and receives `Hello, Ada!`.
Set a custom greeting by overriding the row in the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`:
